newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistani stocks end flat as index rebounds.
newsitem.headline: Pakistani stocks end flat as index rebounds.

text.p: Pakistani stocks ended almost flat on Friday as the index rebounded on buying of select blue chips towards the close, but the overall sentiment remained weak owing to political and economic uncertainty, dealers said.

"The market opened weak, but index rebounded towards the close on speculative buying and short-covering of select blue chips," dealer Mohammad Iqbal said. "But investors' morale is down because they have taken a heavy beating in a short spell."
The Karachi Stock Exchange 100-share index rose 0.18 points, or 0.01 percent, to end at 1,588.23. Losers beat gainers 225 to 65. PTCL rose 0.55 to 30.30 rupees. -- Amir Zia 9221-5685192
